bio.text: Ned Lamont has been Governor of Connecticut since January 9, 2019, and began a second term on January 4, 2023; he is the Democratic nominee for a third term in 2026.
Before becoming governor he founded a weekly newspaper, served on the Greenwich Board of Selectmen and Board of Estimate and Taxation, and chaired the State Investment Advisory Council.

According to his campaign website, he started a business serving college campuses and holds degrees from Harvard College and the Yale School of Management; CT Mirror reports he won the 2006 Democratic U.S. Senate primary against Joe Lieberman.
